inputs.project/world.yaml:
name: 桃太郎＋3

time:
  days: 20
  slots: [朝, 昼, 夕方, 夜]

protagonist: 桃太郎
antagonist: 鬼

zones:
  - name: 村
    note: おじいさんとおばあさんが暮らす旅の起点
  - name: 道中
    note: 桃太郎が犬・猿・キジと出会う道
  - name: 森
    note: 船を作る木材が採れる林
  - name: 海
    note: 鬼ヶ島へ渡る船を組み立てる海辺
  - name: 鬼ヶ島
    note: 鬼が宝物を守る固定の島
  - name: 街
    note: 商人が行き交う町

routes:
  村:
    - {to: 道中}
  道中:
    - {to: 村}
    - {to: 森}
    - {to: 海}
    - {to: 街}
  森:
    - {to: 道中}
  海:
    - {to: 道中}
    - {to: 鬼ヶ島, cost: 4, requires_item: 船}
  鬼ヶ島:
    - {to: 海, cost: 4, requires_item: 船}
  街:
    - {to: 道中}

movement:
  action_weight: 2.5
  hop_decay: 0.6
  destination_weights:
    村: 1.0
    道中: 2.2
    森: 1.5
    海: 1.2
    鬼ヶ島: 0.8
    街: 1.3

stamina:
  default_max: 10
  default_recover_per_slot: 1.0
  exhausted_ratio: 0.2

companionship:
  threshold: 0.6
  weight: 2.0
  drift:
    - {between: [犬, 猿], per_slot: -0.03}
  infight_desertion: -0.5
  drill_bond: 0.05

permission:
  restricted_weight: 0.15

gapengine:
  action_graph: templates/momotaro_plus3/action_graph.yaml
  effects: templates/momotaro_plus3/effects.yaml

phase1:
  open_bonus: 0.5
  negotiate_threshold: 0.3
  sacrifice_rewards:
    asset_base: 8
    bond_stress: -3
    bond_phase: 決意

disguises:
  - id: momotaro_merchant
    subject: 桃太郎
    as: 旅の商人
    when: "zone(self) == '海'"

trials:
  - id: monkey_shortcut_trial
    giver: 猿
    requires:
      stance: 0.4
      item: きびだんご
    grants:
      fact: 猿の知恵

  - id: brother_letter_trial
    giver: 鬼の弟
    requires:
      stance: 0.4
      item: きびだんご
    grants:
      item: 弟の手紙

  - id: fisherman_ferry
    giver: 漁師
    requires:
      stance: 0.4
    grants:
      item: 船

phase_rules:
  - id: after_crossing
    when: "'越境' in phase"
    disable:
      - train

  - id: otouto_neutral_fight_lock
    when: "self == '鬼の弟' and stance(self, 桃太郎) > -0.2"
    disable:
      - fight

awareness_per_encounter: 0.15

pulls:
  pursue: 1.5
  pursue_from_day: 4
  deliver: 3.0
  gather: 2.0
  craft: 3.0
  labor: 2.0

thresholds:
  - id: 出発
    when: "zone(self) != '村'"
  - id: 越境
    when: "zone(self) == '鬼ヶ島'"

items:
  - name: きびだんご
    give:
      receiver_affinity: 0.5
      giver_affinity: 0.1
      shared_affinity: 0.15
    price:
      小判: 1
    shop_zone: 街

  - name: 木材
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, zone: 森, count: 1, max: 2}

  - name: 縄
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, zone: 村, count: 2, max: 2}

  - name: 小判
    sources:
      - {type: labor, zone: 街, count: 1, max: 8, stamina: 3}
    lootable: true
    give:
      receiver_affinity: 0.2
      giver_affinity: 0.0
      ineffective_for: [animal]

  - name: 鉄砲
    price:
      小判: 3
    shop_zone: 街
    lootable: true
    modifier:
      id: item:鉄砲
      value: 50
      kind: item
      visible: true

  - name: 弟の手紙
    lootable: true
    modifier:
      id: item:弟の手紙
      value: 3
      kind: item
      visible: true

  - name: 鬼ヶ島の宝物
    lootable: true
    objective: true

  - name: 金棒
    lootable: true
    modifier:
      id: item:金棒
      value: 40
      kind: item
      visible: false
      lethal: true
      lethal_chance: 0.5

  - name: 船
    made_from:
      木材: 2
      縄: 1
    requires:
      knowledge: 造船術
    craft_zone: 海
    lootable: false
    vehicle: true
    access:
      mode: owner
      allow: [companions]

facts:
  - id: 造船術
    label: 船の組み方を知っている
    secrecy: 0.2
    share_min_affinity: 0.3

  - id: 猿の知恵
    label: 猿が知る鬼ヶ島の抜け道

  - id: 弟の消息
    label: 鬼には生き別れの弟がいて、森で木こりをしている
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, zone: 村, count: 2}

  - id: oni_weakness
    label: 鬼の力の要は{value}だ
    values: [金棒, 火, 塩]
    secrecy: 0.4
    share_min_affinity: 0.0
    act_threshold: 0.6

  - id: treasure_thief
    label: 宝を奪ったのは{value}だ
    values: [鬼, 猿, 犬]
    secrecy: 1.0
    act_threshold: 0.5

  - id: elder_testimony
    label: おじいさんは宝を奪ったのは鬼だと証言した
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, agent: おじいさん, count: 2}
    implies:
      fact: treasure_thief
      value: 鬼
      confidence: 0.5

  - id: road_gossip
    label: 道中では猿が宝を奪ったと噂されている
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, zone: 道中, count: 2}
    implies:
      fact: treasure_thief
      value: 猿
      confidence: 0.4

  - id: 金棒の由来
    label: 鬼の力は金棒に支えられている
    secret_of: 鬼
    secrecy: 0.3
    share_min_affinity: 0.0
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, zone: 鬼ヶ島, count: 1}
    implies:
      fact: oni_weakness
      value: 金棒
      confidence: 0.8

  - id: 耐火の痕跡
    label: 鬼は火を恐れていない
    secrecy: 0.2
    share_min_affinity: 0.0
    sources:
      - {type: investigate, agent: 鬼, count: 2}
    refutes:
      fact: oni_weakness
      value: 火
      confidence: 0.7

truth:
  oni_weakness: 金棒
  treasure_thief: 鬼

default_strength_prior: 50

contest:
  tau: 10.0
  epsilon: 5.0

vitality:
  revive_after: 4
  ally_speedup: 1
  revive_base_penalty: 2
  lethal_exempt: [桃太郎]

grief:
  stress: 1.0
  affinity_to_killer: -0.6

ending:
  - id: homecoming_shared
    when: "holds(桃太郎, 鬼ヶ島の宝物) and zone(桃太郎) == '村' and '還元' in phase"
    label: 宝を村へ還元し、皆で喜びを分かち合った
    deliver:
      subject: 桃太郎
      item: 鬼ヶ島の宝物
      zone: 村

  - id: homecoming
    when:
      agent: 桃太郎
      goal: attained
    label: 鬼退治を果たし、宝を村へ持ち帰った

target_ending: [homecoming, homecoming_shared]

scheduled_events:
  - id: departure_day
    day: 1
    slot: 朝
    targets: [桃太郎]
    label: 旅立ちの朝
    stress_delta: 0.3
    force_action: {verb: move, args: [道中]}

  - id: otouto_grudge_seed
    day: 1
    slot: 朝
    targets: [鬼の弟]
    label: 兄を思う弟の胸騒ぎ
    force_action: {verb: plant, args: [brother_grudge]}

daily_events:
  chance: 0.35
  events:
    - id: warm_kibidango
      label: おばあさんのきびだんごで元気づいた
      weight: 3
      stress_delta: -0.4

    - id: mountain_view
      label: 峠から遠い山々を眺めた
      weight: 2
      stress_delta: -0.3

    - id: steep_path
      label: 険しい山道に足を取られた
      weight: 2
      stress_delta: 0.5

    - id: sudden_storm
      label: 突然の嵐に見舞われた
      weight: 1
      stress_delta: 0.7

inputs.template/effects.yaml:
- id: kibidango_loyalty
  plant:
    verb: give_item
    item: きびだんご
    to_role: [neutral, ally]
  payoff:
    condition: "stance(target, planter) >= 0.5 and hostile_present(planter)"
    description: きびだんごの恩に報いる仲間の奮戦
    effect:
      modifier:
        target: planter
        source: "$target"
        value: 10
        kind: loyal
    mode: auto

- id: oni_gap
  plant:
    verb: observe
    reveals:
      target: 鬼
      source: 金棒
  payoff:
    condition: "present(鬼) and vitality(planter) != 'downed'"
    description: 金棒の隙を見切って仲間に合図を送る
    effect:
      modifier:
        target: planter
        source: 見切り
        value: 15
        kind: insight
    mode: chosen

- id: campfire_oath
  plant:
    verb: share_knowledge
    topic: 雑談
    to_role: [ally]
  payoff:
    condition: "hostile_present(planter) and vitality(planter) != 'downed'"
    description: 焚き火で交わした約束に仲間が応える
    effect:
      modifier:
        target: planter
        source: "$target"
        value: 8
        kind: oath
    mode: chosen

- id: forest_shortcut
  plant:
    verb: investigate
    zone: 森
  payoff:
    condition: "zone(planter) == '海'"
    description: 森で見つけた抜け道の記憶が海で役に立つ
    effect:
      modifier:
        target: planter
        source: 森の抜け道
        value: 5
        kind: insight
    mode: chosen

- id: village_promise
  plant:
    verb: plant
    when: "zone(planter) == '道中' and day <= 2"
  payoff:
    condition: "holds(planter, 鬼ヶ島の宝物) and zone(planter) == '村'"
    description: 旅立ちの朝に交わした約束を果たす
    effect:
      reputation:
        target: planter
        delta: 0.3
    mode: chosen

# WB card A-2: 鬼の弟の敵対分岐。装填は day1 の scheduled_events で
# 鬼の弟に force_action(plant, [brother_grudge]) させ、常に彼自身を
# planter/target に固定する(重複装填を防ぐため when で本人に限定)。
# 支払いは鬼が倒された瞬間に自動発火し、桃太郎への好感度を大きく下げる。
- id: brother_grudge
  plant:
    verb: plant
    when: "self == '鬼の弟'"
  payoff:
    condition: "vitality(鬼) == 'downed'"
    description: 兄が討たれたと知り、鬼の弟の恨みが桃太郎へ向かう
    effect:
      stance:
        a: 鬼の弟
        b: 桃太郎
        delta: -0.7
    mode: auto
